name: @compaction/cli
description: Install once and route Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor through a local, byte-safe Gateway — measure token & cache usage with content-free receipts and shape responses before generation for shorter output. Local-first, no account required, no prompt or code telemetry. Adaptive input compaction needs a free account and the separately delivered engine.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke:package
scripts.analyze:demo: npm run analyze:demo:login && npm run analyze:demo:coding && npm run analyze:demo:support && npm run analyze:demo:rag
scripts.compact:demo: npm run compact:demo:login && npm run compact:demo:coding && npm run compact:demo:support && npm run compact:demo:rag
scripts.run:demo: npm run dev -- run -- node src/examples/repeated-output-command.js
scripts.codex:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts import src/examples/codex-exec-demo.jsonl --source codex-exec-jsonl --out .compaction/imports/codex-demo && tsx src/cli/index.ts analyze .compaction/imports/codex-demo/captured-trace.json && tsx src/cli/index.ts recommend .compaction/imports/codex-demo/captured-trace.json && tsx src/cli/index.ts compact .compaction/imports/codex-demo/captured-trace.json --out .compaction/imports/codex-demo/compacted
scripts.adapter:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts adapter validate src/examples/demo-messages-trace.json --source messages
scripts.approve:demo: npm run optimize:openai-agents:demo && tsx src/cli/index.ts approve $(node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='.compaction/optimizations/openai-agents'; const dirs=fs.readdirSync(path,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>d.name).sort(); process.stdout.write(dirs.at(-1));") --require-safety-pass
scripts.spend:demo: npm run optimize:openai-agents:demo && tsx src/cli/index.ts spend $(node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=".compaction/optimizations/openai-agents"; const dirs=fs.readdirSync(path,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>d.name).sort(); process.stdout.write(path+"/"+dirs.at(-1)+"/optimization-summary.json");')
scripts.review:demo: npm run optimize:openai-agents:demo && tsx src/cli/index.ts review $(node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=".compaction/optimizations/openai-agents"; const dirs=fs.readdirSync(path,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>d.name).sort(); process.stdout.write(path+"/"+dirs.at(-1)+"/optimization-summary.json");') --require-safety-pass
scripts.integrations:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts integrations run openai-agents --out .compaction/integrations -- node src/examples/openai-agents-real-workflow.js
